claims: Forza Horizon 6 is scheduled for release on May 19, 2026, for Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam and Windows.
PlayStation 5 version of Forza Horizon 6 arriving later in 2026.
Forza Horizon 6 is set in Japan.

Forza Horizon 6 has deep customization options.
